claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings; consider weaning assessment as FiO2 has decreased and spontaneous breathing is present.

Reposition and manage pressure areas per Braden score; maintain skin integrity.
Assess and manage pain with acetaminophen and opioids as ordered, monitoring response.
